hazards.control: Instrument power isolated before sensor changes; cables routed off the ground.

tabs.overview: Each pump reports to the van; the treater sees which pump is in which gear and pulls one out of the lineup when its numbers drift.
tabs.engineering: Vendor telemetry; kickout setpoints pushed to each pump.
tabs.evidence: Field practice at the frac van and wellsite instrumentation (S9); pressure transducer practice (S31 missile patent for header instruments); no vendor data.

name: Pump and fleet monitoring
function: The data from each pump (rate, discharge pressure, gear, engine load, fluid end vibration) over the fleet network to the van, used to balance the spread and catch a failing pump.
